beats: My daily video digest writes a script for each news beat, then has to guess which graphic fits it.
The script writer described a visual idea in prose; the renderer just guessed, from its own fixed list.
Now both sides read from one shared catalog of effects, built with Remotion.
No more generic fallback graphics — percent rings, region callouts and timelines get picked by name instead.
That catalog started at 12 effects and grew, the same evening, to 23.
